summary: A return from within for...of closes the iterator before leaving the containing function.

semantics.function_return: original return value unless close throws

tests.name: return closes generator
tests.input: function* g(){try{yield 1}finally{console.log("close")}} function f(){for(const x of g())return 9} console.log(f());

tests.name: close throw replaces return
tests.input: const it={next(){return {value:1,done:false}},return(){throw "close"},[Symbol.iterator](){return this}}; function f(){for(const x of it)return 9} try{f()}catch(e){console.log(e)}
